title: Manage your fines with a MyServiceNSW Account
summary: Use your MyServiceNSW Account to view, pay, or query your fines online in one convenient location.
intro:
You can view, pay or query fines online with your MyServiceNSW Account. You'll see fine records with due dates, amounts owing and statuses all in one convenient location.

It is quicker and easier to manage your fines online, as your details will be pre-filled. You can securely:
who_can_apply: Must be able to provide two matching identity documents (e.g., Australian driver licence, Medicare card, passport).
what_you_need: Personal and contact details (name, date of birth, address, email, and phone number).
Two identity documents (names must match and match the name on the fine).
A fine or overdue fine reference number (if adding the Fines service for the first time).

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
connect your account with Revenue NSW with a fine reference number.

more_info.text: Download the Service NSW app to view or pay a fine.

internal_links.text: Request a review for a fine
Nominate someone else for a fine
Apply to go to court for a fine

faqs.q: How can I manage my fines online?
faqs.a: You can view, pay, or query fines online using your MyServiceNSW Account. Your fine records, including due dates, amounts owing, and statuses, will all be in one place.

faqs.q: What do I need to manage my fines online?
faqs.a: You need your personal and contact details (name, date of birth, address, email, and phone number), two matching identity documents (like a driver licence, Medicare card, or passport), a MyServiceNSW Account, and potentially a fine or overdue fine reference number.

faqs.q: What if I live overseas or don't have required ID documents?
faqs.a: If you are an NSW resident living overseas or do not have the required proof of identity documents, you must visit the NSW Government website to manage your fines.
